newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen stabilising after growth.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen stabilising after growth.

text.p: Polish shares were seen flat after a 2.8- percent gain in the last two sessions, with investor attention focused on National Investment Funds (NFIs) in the second day of their bourse trade, analysts said.
Some analysts said , however, the market might fall in profit-taking after the strong growth.

They said NFI units could rise to match the NIF index, calculated as a sum of NFI prices, which closed at 160 points on Thursday. The units traded at 150 zlotys in the single price auction system.--Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
